g.text: likes, reposts, saves, follows, blocks and comment
likes are many-to-many associations: each is stored as
a join table holding the pair and a date, with a
role and plan are NULL for a magazine account,
enforced by a CHECK constraint. They are
orthogonal: a writer may stay on the free plan.
publisherId names the magazine that published a
licensed article; it is NULL for everything else.
